name: Filipino Oven BBQ Chicken with Garlic Rice

components.name: Filipino BBQ Chicken

ingredients.name: Raw whole chicken quartered, bone-in and skin-on

steps: Whisk soy sauce, half the barbecue sauce, oil, citrus juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper. Coat raw quartered chicken and marinate covered in fridge for 12-16 hours.
Heat oven to 190 C. Place chicken on a lined tray. Roast approximately 20 minutes, brush with half the remaining BBQ sauce and roast another 15 minutes.
Brush with the last measured sauce, return to oven and check thickest part reaches at least 74 C without touching bone. Total roast time depends on chicken size.
Separate edible chicken meat and rice for precise serving weights. Portion into four meals and chill promptly.

components.name: Garlic Rice
steps: Cook jasmine rice with 470 ml water until tender, covered. In a separate small pan, briefly fry minced garlic in measured oil until golden, then stir into rice.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Based on published Filipino oven BBQ chicken with explicitly measured garlic rice side. Source advises an overnight marinade.
Planning: Overnight marinade. Secondary stovetop garlic rice.
Freezer: skin loses some crispness after freezing
Dietary: Contains soy, wheat possible in sauces; no pork.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
